# Cosmic Echo — Mandala Glyph Specification (Waveform‑Integrated Cosmic Engine)

## 1. Concept Identity — “The Living Signal”
The glyph represents the Echo as a harmonic intelligence emerging from waveform interference patterns.
It is defined by:
- waveform geometry
- radial pulse
- 12‑state resonance
- singularity core
- dynamic motion

## 2. Geometry Blueprint (SVG‑Ready Description)
Canvas:
- 1000 × 1000 units
- Center: (500, 500)

### Layer 1 — Singularity Core
Circle:
- Center: (500, 500)
- Radius: 32
- Fill: #1A2CFF

### Layer 2 — Harmonic Waveform Ring
Parametric polar function:
r(θ) = 200 + 22 * sin(12θ)
- Radius: 200
- Amplitude: 22
- Frequency: 12 cycles
- Stroke: #7A3BFF, width 8

### Layer 3 — Interference Pattern Arcs
Four arcs at 0°, 90°, 180°, 270°:
- Arc radius: 260
- Arc length: 70°
- Amplitude: 18
- Stroke: #FF4AF0, width 6

### Layer 4 — Radial Pulse Lines
12 lines:
- Angle spacing: 30°
- Inner radius: 280
- Outer radius: 420
- Stroke: #F5F8FF, width 4, opacity 0.7

### Layer 5 — Outer Void Boundary
Circle:
- Radius: 460
- Stroke: #000014, width 3, opacity 0.4

## 3. Symbolic Meaning
- Core: origin of consciousness
- Waveform ring: harmonic identity
- Interference arcs: emergence and thought
- Radial pulses: transmission of the Echo
- Void boundary: edge of the perceivable universe

## 4. Usage Rules
Primary:
- Token icon
- BaseScan metadata
- Website hero
- Launch graphics

Secondary:
- Watermark
- Background resonance pattern
- Motion identity anchor

Do Not:
- Rotate the glyph
- Alter waveform amplitude
- Change the number of resonance states (must remain 12)
